notes: Conjugates with the suffix -уй- in the present tense (я рисую, ты рисуешь, они рисуют).
In everyday speech, рисовать covers both drawing (with pencils or pens) and painting (with brushes and paints). Professional artists often use писать for painting in oils or watercolors.

faults.quote: though you can also use живописать for painting in a more artistic
faults.why: Misleading: живописать is archaic/bookish; artists actually use писать (писа́ть маслом) for serious painting.

faults.quote: Do not confuse it with писать, which means to write text rather
faults.why: False: писать IS used by artists to mean 'to paint' (писать картину маслом).
Professional oil painting by an artist is normally 'писать маслом', not 'рисовать маслом'.
